findings.F1: The step 5 result is zero, not short of the bar on the predicted side. Over all folds the slope of the 3-day excess return on the forecast is -2.3e-05 with t -0.05 (1398 cases, 634 days), and the size is +0.10 % per case against the idea (t 0.41, 885 days). Even in folds B and C the 3-day slope on depth is only +0.0028 with t 0.84 (408 cases), so more data is not what the test lacks.
findings.F2: The effect grows with the horizon in the choppy profile (folds B, C, slope of excess return on depth, day-clustered t):
findings.F3: The effect sits in the deepest closes only (folds B, C, choppy):
findings.F4: The effect is mixed across periods and coins. At 3 days the deepest fifth falls in 2018 (-3.3 %), 2019 (-1.8 %) and 2020 (-9.4 %) but rises in 2021 (+1.4 %). The 3-day slope is negative for LTC (t -0.57) and ZEC (t -0.77) and positive for BTC, ETH, XMR and XRP (t 0.7 to 1.8). The 10-day deepest fifth is negative in every year and every coin.
findings.F5: The brief's claim that the effect holds after up and down days alike is borne out: 1-day slope t 1.25 after up days and 0.74 after down days; 3-day slope t 1.69 and 0.20.
findings.F6: The same deepening shows outside the choppy profile too (non-choppy slope t 1.94 at 5 days, 1.41 at 10 days). It is not a choppy-only effect, but the brief names choppy, so the profile is kept.
findings.F7: Its size against the cost: at 3 days the total move per case is -1.3 times the 0.19 % trade cost (against the short) and the unusual move 0.5 times. The deepest cases' 10-day excess fall of about 8 % is many times that cost. A clear answer needs the horizon where the move is large.

ideas.idea: In a choppy market, the further a coin's close sits below its 20-day high, in units of its 20-day daily-return standard deviation, the larger its fall over the next ten days.
ideas.consequence: A close far below the range's top in a sideways market is a reason to stay short, or to refuse a long, for about two weeks rather than for a few days.
ideas.name: choppy deep close ten-day fall

ideas.idea: In a choppy market, the further a coin's close sits below its 20-day high, in units of its 20-day daily-return standard deviation, the larger its fall over the next five days.
ideas.consequence: The selling after a deep close in a sideways market takes about a week to play out, so a short taken on it should be held that long.
ideas.name: choppy deep close five-day fall
